title: LinkClient
description: A lightweight, performance-focused modpack for Minecraft.
body:
## 📖 What are the features of this modpack
- Excellent optimization: Comprehensive improvements to entities, blocks, and memory for higher in-game FPS.

- Smoother mouse movement: Ixeris ensures that high-polling-rate mice don't cause significant frame drops when turning the camera.

- Convenient survival assistance: The pack includes survival aid mods such as Tweakeroo, Litematica, Minihud, Item Scroller, and Tweakermore, providing effective and convenient support for your gameplay on servers.

## 📋 Mod List
<details> <summary>Click to expand (using version 26.1.2 as an example)</summary>
  
**Performance Optimization**\
Sodium, Lithium, VMP, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, More Culling, Cull Leaves, BadOptimizations, ImmediatelyFast, Lazy Language Loader, Language Reload.

**Survival Assistance**\
Tweakeroo, Litematica, Minihud, Item Scroller, Tweakermore, Jade, Shulker Box Tooltip, Inventory Profiles Next, Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's Worldmap, XaeroPlus, Zoomify, Dynamic Crosshair.

**Visual Enhancements**\
Iris, Continuity, CustomSkinLoader, SkinLayers 3D, Entity Texture Features, Entity Model Features, Sodium Extra, Reese's Sodium Options, Gamma Utils.

**Client Misc**\
Chat Heads, NoChat Reports, AppleSkin, Detail Armor Bar, Inventory HUD, Dynamic FPS, Mod Menu, RRLS, AutoFish, Fast IP Ping, Server Pinger Fixer, Entity View Distance, CWB, Gnetum, Ixeris, BBE, IMBlocker.

</details>

## 💡 Supported Versions
| Game Version | Maintained |
| --- | --- |
| 26.1.2 | Yes |
## ❓ Q&A
> Q: Why does PVP feel sluggish?
> A: ImmediatelyFast and Gnetum affect GUI rendering. If PVP doesn't feel responsive, you can remove these two mods.

> Q: Can client-side helper features (e.g., Freecam) be considered cheating by servers?
> A: Some servers do consider these features as cheating. Please ask the server owner or admin before using them.

> Q: Does the modpack include shaders?
> A: The pack includes Iris, but does not come with any shader packs. You can add shader files of your choice (place them in the shaderpacks folder).

> Q: Can I add more mods?
> A: Yes, this pack focuses on being lightweight. Most mods won't conflict with it.

## 💬 Who is this for?
1.Players who enjoy redstone mechanics and are on servers that support redstone gameplay.

2.Players with low-end hardware who enjoy playing on servers.

3.Players with high-end hardware who want to push both lower and upper performance limits.
